constantStrand.Caveat:
Caveat

This function should be defined for any graded chain complex, not just ones created using res(I, Strategy=>4).
constantStrand.Description:
Description

Warning! This function is very rough currently. It works if one uses it in the intended manner, as in the example below. But it should be much more general, handling other rings with grace, and also it should handle arbitrary (graded) chain complexes.

i1 : R = ZZ/101[a..d]

o1 = R

o1 : PolynomialRing
i2 : I = ideal(a^3, b^3, c^3, d^3, (a+3*b+7*c-4*d)^3)

             3   3   3   3   3     2         2      3      2                 2         2        2      3      2                2                         2         2        2        2      3
o2 = ideal (a , b , c , d , a  + 9a b + 27a*b  + 27b  + 21a c + 25a*b*c - 13b c + 46a*c  + 37b*c  + 40c  - 12a d + 29a*b*d - 7b d + 34a*c*d + b*c*d + 18c d + 48a*d  + 43b*d  + 33c*d  + 37d )

o2 : Ideal of R
i3 : C = res(I, Strategy=>4)

      1      9      25      31      18      4
o3 = R  <-- R  <-- R   <-- R   <-- R   <-- R
                                            
     0      1      2       3       4       5

o3 : ChainComplex
i4 : betti C

            0 1  2  3  4 5
o4 = total: 1 9 25 31 18 4
         0: 1 .  .  .  . .
         1: . .  .  .  . .
         2: . 5  1  .  . .
         3: . 1  3  1  . .
         4: . 3 17 13  4 .
         5: . .  4 13 10 3
         6: . .  .  4  3 1
         7: . .  .  .  1 .

o4 : BettiTally
i5 : CR = constantStrand(C, 5)

             ZZ 3       ZZ 3
o5 = 0 <-- (---)  <-- (---)  <-- 0 <-- 0 <-- 0
            101        101                    
     0                           3     4     5
           1          2

o5 : ChainComplex
i6 : CR.dd_2

o6 = | -33 48  0   |
     | 2   -15 5   |
     | 2   0   -43 |

Headline: constantStrand
-- a constant strand of a chain complex
constantStrand.Synopsis:
• Usage:
    Cd = constantStrand(C, deg)
  • Inputs:
    • C, a chain complex, a chain complex created using (the unsupported) res(I, Strategy=>4.1)
    • deg, an integer, the degree of the strand of the complex
  • Outputs:
    • Cd, a chain complex, a chain complex over kk, consisting of the submatrices of C of degree deg
